title: ARAGNATION
author: Devi Parikh and Abhishek Das
facts: data contracts — plain number arrays in 7 locked script chunks on the Art Blocks core
an RGB color per (x, y) coordinate; some works use palette coloring instead
description: Aragnation draws abstract compositions with a watercolor look. A small neural network learned to map each (x, y) position to a color. Its weights sit as plain numbers inside the project script, in seven locked data chunks on Ethereum. Your browser reads the script from Ethereum and runs it. Some works use palettes instead of the network.

call.note: projectScriptByIndex(401, 3) — reads part 3 of 7 of the onchain program; this part is entirely model-weight numbers
